class.comment: Generate anonymous GET /connect/authorize plus anonymous GET and POST /connect/callback endpoints for the Authorization Code flow. Validate required authorize parameters, response_type=code, active OAuth Client, exact registered redirect URI, requested case-sensitive Scopes, allowed grants, and S256 PKCE before any provider redirect. Select the preferred active eligible provider or highest-priority active eligible provider. Protect ten-minute single-use correlation state binding client identifier, redirect URI, granted Scopes, PKCE challenge and method, nonce, and caller state. Process query and form_post callbacks through validated external-provider results, link or create External Identity and User according to Invite Only/Open SSO access mode, establish the opaque server-side SSO Session, issue a five-minute one-time Authorization Code bound to client, exact redirect, User, granted Scopes, PKCE challenge, and nonce, then redirect exactly with code and original state. Treat configured client Scopes as pre-authorized and never issue unknown or disallowed Scopes.
class.name: SecurityAuthorityAuthorizationEndpoints
